name: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton-Herriman / Orem / Logan) Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich & Chicken Noodle Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton / Orem / Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Located across Logan, Orem (near BambooHR), Draper, and Riverton/Herriman, Café Zupas' Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich on soft white cottage bread paired with Chickpea & Vegetable-free Chicken Noodle Soup and a soft white bread roll is an easy, repeatable Try-2 combo.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Try-2 Combo with a Turkey Bacon Avocado Sandwich on white bread (ask for no tomatoes or sprouts) and a cup of Chicken Noodle Soup (Plus the complimentary soft white roll; give away or save the chocolate-dipped strawberry if avoiding berry seeds).
watchOuts: The complimentary chocolate-covered strawberry has tiny insoluble seeds on the outside—eat just the chocolate tip or skip during flares
